label: S360 - Panel
info: Endpoints del panel de alarma (sitios, dispositivos, armado/desarmado)

name: Validar JWT
SELECT sites
query:
SELECT id, name, address, latitude, longitude, is_active, created_at
FROM sites
WHERE tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY name;

name: Validar JWT
SELECT devices
query:
SELECT d.id, d.serial_number, d.device_type, d.firmware_version, d.status,
       d.bound_at, d.unbound_at, d.site_id, s.name as site_name
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id = d.site_id
WHERE d.tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY s.name, d.device_type;
